Hamilton, M. (1969). «Diagnosis and rating of anxiety », Bri-

Hasin, D.S. & al. (2007). « Prevalence, correlates, disability,

Hofmann, S. G. & al. (2012). «The efcacy of cognitive

Kaplan, H. I. & al. (1994). Synopsis of Psychiatry, Baltimore,

Kendler, K. S. & al. (2000). « Parenting and adult mood,

Kessler, R. C. & Wang, P. S. (2008). « The descriptive
epidemiology of commonly occurring mental disorders in

LeBeau, R. T. & al. (2010). «Specic phobia : A review of

de l’adulte, Paris, Masson.
